title_en: Clearing opportunity!! At the Aviation Field, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Spaces!!
description_en: At the Aviation Field, in the "EB Construction" Complex, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Spaces. It is organized in an entrance corridor that divides the premises, a spacious living room with a kitchenette, a matrimonial room and a toilet. The complex offers recreational areas, play areas for children and many services and facilities for a better life in the community. The area where it is located is one of the most preferred in Tirana due to the construction with a plan where the spaces and access are very well respected.
